## Core User Flow Testing Framework

### 1. Chief Data Officer (CDO) Workflow

**Primary Flow: Executive Dashboard Creation and Insights Review**

```typescript
// e2e/tests/cdo-workflow.spec.ts
import { test, expect, Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { CDOUser, TestData, DashboardBuilder } from '../utils';

describe('CDO Complete Workflow', () => {
  let page: Page;
  let cdoUser: CDOUser;
  
  beforeEach(async ({ browser }) => {
    page = await browser.newPage();
    cdoUser = new CDOUser(page);
    await cdoUser.login();
  });

  test('Complete CDO Journey: Login to Insights Export', async () => {
    // Step 1: Dashboard Overview Access (Target: <2s)
    await test.step('Dashboard Overview Access', async () => {
      const startTime = Date.now();
      await cdoUser.navigateToDashboard();
      
      // Validate dashboard loads within performance threshold
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard-overview"]')).toBeVisible();
      const loadTime = Date.now() - startTime;
      expect(loadTime).toBeLessThan(2000);
      
      // Validate key metrics display
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="revenue-metric"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="growth-metric"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="performance-metric"]')).toBeVisible();
    });

    // Step 2: Custom Report Creation (Target: <5 clicks)
    await test.step('Custom Report Creation', async () => {
      const dashboardBuilder = new DashboardBuilder(page);
      
      // Create new dashboard
      await page.click('[data-testid="create-dashboard-btn"]');
      await page.fill('[data-testid="dashboard-name"]', 'Executive Q4 Performance');
      
      // Add revenue trend chart
      await dashboardBuilder.addChart({
        type: 'line',
        dataSource: 'sales_data',
        metrics: ['revenue', 'growth_rate'],
        timeframe: 'quarterly'
      });
      
      // Add regional performance comparison
      await dashboardBuilder.addChart({
        type: 'bar',
        dataSource: 'regional_sales',
        metrics: ['total_sales', 'market_share'],
        groupBy: 'region'
      });
      
      // Add KPI cards
      await dashboardBuilder.addMetricCard('total_revenue', '$2.8M');
      await dashboardBuilder.addMetricCard('growth_rate', '+12.5%');
      await dashboardBuilder.addMetricCard('customer_acquisition', '847');
      
      // Save dashboard
      await page.click('[data-testid="save-dashboard"]');
      
      // Validate dashboard creation success
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="success-notification"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('text=Executive Q4 Performance')).toBeVisible();
    });

    // Step 3: AI Insights Review (Target: Insights generated <3s)
    await test.step('AI Insights Review', async () => {
      // Navigate to insights panel
      await page.click('[data-testid="insights-tab"]');
      
      // Wait for AI insights generation
      await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
      
      // Validate insights presence
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="ai-insights-container"]')).toBeVisible();
      
      // Check for different insight types
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="trend-insight"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="anomaly-insight"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="forecast-insight"]')).toBeVisible();
      
      // Validate insight confidence scores
      const confidenceScores = await page.locator('[data-testid="confidence-score"]').all();
      for (const score of confidenceScores) {
        const scoreText = await score.textContent();
        const numericScore = parseFloat(scoreText.replace('%', ''));
        expect(numericScore).toBeGreaterThan(70); // Minimum confidence threshold
      }
    });

    // Step 4: Export and Sharing (Target: Export <5s)
    await test.step('Export and Sharing', async () => {
      // Export dashboard as PDF
      await page.click('[data-testid="export-dropdown"]');
      await page.click('[data-testid="export-pdf"]');
      
      // Wait for export generation
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="export-progress"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="export-complete"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
      
      // Share dashboard via link
      await page.click('[data-testid="share-btn"]');
      await page.click('[data-testid="generate-share-link"]');
      
      // Validate share link generation
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="share-link"]')).toBeVisible();
      const shareLink = await page.locator('[data-testid="share-link"]').inputValue();
      expect(shareLink).toMatch(/^https:\/\/.+\/dashboard\/[a-z0-9-]+$/);
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
// e2e/tests/business-analyst-workflow.spec.ts
describe('Business Analyst Complete Workflow', () => {

      await page.click('[data-testid="post-comment"]');
      
      // Validate comment appears
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="comment-thread"]')).toContainText('Q4 shows strong growth');
      
      // Share with team members
      await page.click('[data-testid="collaborate-btn"]');
      await page.fill('[data-testid="invite-email"]', 'team@quartziq.com');
      await page.click('[data-testid="send-invite"]');
      
      // Enter presentation mode
      await page.click('[data-testid="present-btn"]');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="presentation-mode"]')).toBeVisible();
      
      // Test presentation navigation
      await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');

});
```

```typescript
// e2e/tests/data-scientist-workflow.spec.ts
describe('Data Scientist Advanced Analytics Workflow', () => {
  test('Complete Advanced Analytics Journey', async ({ page }) => {
    const dataScientist = new DataScientistUser(page);
    await dataScientist.login();

    // Step 1: Advanced Analytics Setup (Target: ML model configuration)

      await page.click('[data-testid="advanced-analytics"]');

      // Select analysis type
      await page.selectOption('[data-testid="analysis-type"]', 'predictive_modeling');
      await page.fill('[data-testid="analysis-name"]', 'Customer Churn Prediction');
      
      // Configure data pipeline
      await page.click('[data-testid="configure-pipeline"]');
      await dataScientist.setupDataPipeline({
        source: 'customer_data',
        features: ['tenure', 'monthly_charges', 'total_charges', 'contract_type'],
        target: 'churn_flag'
      });
      
      // Validate pipeline configuration
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="pipeline-status"]')).toContainText('Ready');
    });

    // Step 2: Predictive Modeling (Target: Model training <2 minutes)
    await test.step('Predictive Model Training', async () => {
      // Start model training
      await page.click('[data-testid="train-model"]');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="training-progress"]')).toBeVisible();
      
      // Wait for training completion

      // Validate model metrics

      const precision = await page.locator('[data-testid="model-precision"]').textContent();

      // Create prediction distribution plot
      await dataScientist.createDistributionPlot({
        data: 'churn_predictions',
        type: 'histogram',
        bins: 20
      });
      
      // Validate visualizations render correctly
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="heatmap-chart"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="distribution-chart"]')).toBeVisible();
    });

    // Step 4: API Integration (Target: Model deployment)
    await test.step('Model Deployment and API Integration', async () => {
      // Deploy model as API endpoint
      await page.click('[data-testid="deploy-model"]');
      await page.selectOption('[data-testid="deployment-target"]', 'api_endpoint');
      await page.fill('[data-testid="endpoint-name"]', 'churn-prediction-api');
      
      // Configure API settings
      await page.click('[data-testid="api-settings"]');
      await page.check('[data-testid="enable-rate-limiting"]');
      await page.fill('[data-testid="rate-limit"]', '1000');
      await page.check('[data-testid="enable-authentication"]');
      
      // Deploy and validate
      await page.click('[data-testid="deploy-btn"]');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="deployment-success"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60000 });
      
      // Test API endpoint
      const apiUrl = await page.locator('[data-testid="api-endpoint"]').textContent();
      expect(apiUrl).toMatch(/^https:\/\/.+\/api\/predict\/churn-prediction-api$/);
      
      // Validate API documentation
      await page.click('[data-testid="api-docs"]');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="swagger-ui"]')).toBeVisible();
    });
  });
});
```

## Data Flow Integration Testing

### 1. Real-time Data Processing Pipeline

```typescript
// e2e/tests/data-flow-integration.spec.ts
describe('Data Flow Integration Testing', () => {
  test('Real-time Data Processing Validation', async ({ page }) => {
    const dataFlowTester = new DataFlowTester(page);
    
    // Test 1: Real-time data ingestion (Target: <1s latency)
    await test.step('Real-time Data Ingestion', async () => {
      await dataFlowTester.setupRealTimeStream({
        source: 'kafka_stream',
        topic: 'sales_events',
        batchSize: 100,
        flushInterval: 1000
      });
      
      // Send test events
      const testEvents = dataFlowTester.generateTestEvents(500);
      await dataFlowTester.publishEvents(testEvents);
      
      // Validate events appear in dashboard
      await page.goto('/dashboard/real-time-metrics');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="live-counter"]')).toHaveText('500', { timeout: 2000 });
      
      // Check data freshness indicator
      const lastUpdate = await page.locator('[data-testid="last-update"]').textContent();
      const updateTime = new Date(lastUpdate);
      const now = new Date();
      expect(now.getTime() - updateTime.getTime()).toBeLessThan(5000); // 5 seconds freshness
    });

    // Test 2: Database query optimization (Target: <3s response time)
    await test.step('Database Query Performance', async () => {
      const complexQueries = [
        {
          name: 'Customer Segmentation',
          sql: `SELECT segment, COUNT(*), AVG(total_value) 
                FROM customers c 
                JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id 
                WHERE o.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year'
                GROUP BY segment 
                ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC`,
          expectedRows: 5
        },
        {
          name: 'Monthly Revenue Trend',
          sql: `SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) as month, 
                       SUM(total_amount) as revenue,
                       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as unique_customers
                FROM orders 
                WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 years'
                GROUP BY month 
                ORDER BY month`,
          expectedRows: 24
        }
      ];

      for (const query of complexQueries) {
        const startTime = Date.now();
        
        // Execute query through natural language interface
        await page.fill('[data-testid="query-input"]', query.name.toLowerCase());
        await page.click('[data-testid="execute-query"]');
        
        // Wait for results
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="query-results"]')).toBeVisible();
        
        const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;
        expect(executionTime).toBeLessThan(3000);
        
        // Validate result count
        const resultRows = await page.locator('[data-testid="result-row"]').count();
        expect(resultRows).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(query.expectedRows);
      }
    });

    // Test 3: API endpoint reliability (Target: 99.9% uptime simulation)
    await test.step('API Endpoint Reliability', async () => {
      const apiTester = new APITester();
      const endpoints = [
        '/api/dashboards',
        '/api/queries/execute',
        '/api/insights/generate',
        '/api/exports/pdf'
      ];

      for (const endpoint of endpoints) {
        // Test 100 concurrent requests
        const requests = Array(100).fill(null).map(() => 
          apiTester.makeRequest(endpoint, { timeout: 5000 })
        );

        const results = await Promise.allSettled(requests);
        const successfulRequests = results.filter(r => r.status === 'fulfilled').length;
        const reliabilityRate = (successfulRequests / 100) * 100;

        expect(reliabilityRate).toBeGreaterThan(99); // 99%+ reliability
      }
    });
  });
});
```

### 2. Data Visualization Rendering Performance

```typescript
// e2e/tests/visualization-performance.spec.ts
describe('Data Visualization Performance Testing', () => {
  test('Large Dataset Visualization (1M+ records)', async ({ page }) => {
    const perfTester = new PerformanceTester(page);
    
    await test.step('Large Dataset Handling', async () => {
      // Load large dataset
      await page.goto('/dashboard/performance-test');
      await perfTester.loadLargeDataset(1000000); // 1M records
      
      // Test chart rendering performance
      const chartTypes = ['line', 'bar', 'scatter', 'heatmap'];
      
      for (const chartType of chartTypes) {
        await page.selectOption('[data-testid="chart-type"]', chartType);
        
        const renderStart = Date.now();
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="chart-container"] svg')).toBeVisible();
        const renderTime = Date.now() - renderStart;
        
        // Should render large datasets within 5 seconds
        expect(renderTime).toBeLessThan(5000);
        
        // Validate chart responsiveness
        await page.hover('[data-testid="chart-container"]');
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="tooltip"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 1000 });
      }
    });

    await test.step('Memory Usage Monitoring', async () => {
      const initialMemory = await perfTester.getMemoryUsage();
      
      // Create multiple complex visualizations
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        await perfTester.createComplexVisualization({
          type: 'multi_series_line',
          dataPoints: 50000,
          series: 5
        });
      }
      
      const peakMemory = await perfTester.getMemoryUsage();
      const memoryIncrease = peakMemory - initialMemory;
      
      // Memory usage should not exceed 500MB increase
      expect(memoryIncrease).toBeLessThan(500 * 1024 * 1024);
      
      // Test memory cleanup
      await page.click('[data-testid="clear-all-charts"]');
      await page.waitForTimeout(2000); // Allow garbage collection
      
      const finalMemory = await perfTester.getMemoryUsage();
      const memoryRecovered = peakMemory - finalMemory;
      
      // Should recover at least 80% of memory
      expect(memoryRecovered).toBeGreaterThan(memoryIncrease * 0.8);
    });
  });
});
```

## System Integration Points Testing

### 1. Authentication System Integration

```typescript
// e2e/tests/authentication-integration.spec.ts
describe('Authentication System Integration', () => {
  test('JWT + SSO Integration Flow', async ({ page, context }) => {
    // Test 1: JWT Authentication Flow
    await test.step('JWT Authentication', async () => {
      await page.goto('/login');
      
      // Regular login
      await page.fill('[data-testid="email"]', 'test@quartziq.com');
      await page.fill('[data-testid="password"]', 'testpassword123');
      await page.click('[data-testid="login-btn"]');
      
      // Validate JWT token storage
      const localStorage = await page.evaluate(() => window.localStorage);
      expect(localStorage.accessToken).toBeTruthy();
      expect(localStorage.refreshToken).toBeTruthy();
      
      // Validate token expiration handling
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        localStorage.setItem('accessToken', 'expired_token');
      });
      
      await page.reload();
      // Should automatically refresh token or redirect to login
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
    });

    // Test 2: SAML SSO Integration
    await test.step('SAML SSO Flow', async () => {
      await page.goto('/login');
      await page.click('[data-testid="sso-login"]');
      
      // Should redirect to IdP
      await page.waitForURL(/.*saml.*/, { timeout: 10000 });
      
      // Simulate SAML response (in real test, this would be external IdP)
      await page.goto('/auth/saml/callback?SAMLResponse=test_response');
      
      // Should redirect back to dashboard
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
      
      // Validate user profile from SAML attributes
      await page.click('[data-testid="user-profile"]');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="user-name"]')).toContainText('Test User');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="user-organization"]')).toContainText('Test Org');
    });

    // Test 3: Role-based Access Control
    await test.step('RBAC Validation', async () => {
      const roles = ['admin', 'user', 'viewer'];
      
      for (const role of roles) {
        // Switch to user with specific role
        await switchUserRole(page, role);
        
        // Test access permissions
        const permissionTests = {
          admin: {
            canAccess: ['/admin', '/settings/organization', '/users/manage'],
            cannotAccess: []
          },
          user: {
            canAccess: ['/dashboard', '/analytics', '/reports'],
            cannotAccess: ['/admin', '/settings/organization']
          },
          viewer: {
            canAccess: ['/dashboard', '/reports'],
            cannotAccess: ['/admin', '/settings', '/analytics/create']
          }
        };
        
        const rolePermissions = permissionTests[role];
        
        // Test allowed access
        for (const allowedPath of rolePermissions.canAccess) {
          await page.goto(allowedPath);
          await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="access-denied"]')).not.toBeVisible();
        }
        
        // Test denied access
        for (const deniedPath of rolePermissions.cannotAccess) {
          await page.goto(deniedPath);
          await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="access-denied"]')).toBeVisible();
        }
      }
    });
  });
});
```

### 2. File Upload/Export System

```typescript
// e2e/tests/file-operations.spec.ts
describe('File Upload/Export Integration', () => {
  test('Complete File Operations Flow', async ({ page }) => {
    const fileHandler = new FileHandler(page);
    
    // Test 1: Data File Upload
    await test.step('Data File Upload Processing', async () => {
      await page.goto('/data-sources/upload');
      
      const testFiles = [
        { name: 'sales_data.csv', size: '10MB', type: 'text/csv' },
        { name: 'customers.xlsx', size: '5MB', type: 'application/vnd.ms-excel' },
        { name: 'products.json', size: '2MB', type: 'application/json' }
      ];
      
      for (const file of testFiles) {
        // Upload file
        await fileHandler.uploadFile(file);
        
        // Validate upload progress
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="upload-progress"]')).toBeVisible();
        
        // Wait for processing completion
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="processing-complete"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30000 });
        
        // Validate data preview
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="data-preview"]')).toBeVisible();
        const rowCount = await page.locator('[data-testid="preview-row"]').count();
        expect(rowCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        
        // Validate column detection
        const columnHeaders = await page.locator('[data-testid="column-header"]').allTextContents();
        expect(columnHeaders.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      }
    });

    // Test 2: Export Functionality
    await test.step('Export Operations', async () => {
      await page.goto('/dashboard/sample-dashboard');
      
      const exportFormats = ['pdf', 'excel', 'powerpoint', 'image'];
      
      for (const format of exportFormats) {
        // Initiate export
        await page.click('[data-testid="export-dropdown"]');
        await page.click(`[data-testid="export-${format}"]`);
        
        // Configure export options
        if (format === 'pdf') {
          await page.selectOption('[data-testid="pdf-layout"]', 'landscape');
          await page.check('[data-testid="include-data-tables"]');
        } else if (format === 'excel') {
          await page.check('[data-testid="include-raw-data"]');
          await page.check('[data-testid="multiple-sheets"]');
        }
        
        await page.click('[data-testid="confirm-export"]');
        
        // Validate export process
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="export-progress"]')).toBeVisible();
        
        // Wait for completion (timeout based on complexity)
        const timeout = format === 'powerpoint' ? 15000 : 8000;
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="download-ready"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout });
        
        // Validate download link
        const downloadLink = await page.locator('[data-testid="download-link"]').getAttribute('href');
        expect(downloadLink).toMatch(new RegExp(`\\.${format === 'image' ? 'png' : format}$`));
      }
    });
```

## Performance Under Load Testing

### 1. Concurrent User Simulation

```typescript
// e2e/tests/load-performance.spec.ts
describe('Performance Under Load Testing', () => {
  test('Concurrent User Load Simulation', async ({ browser }) => {
    const loadTester = new LoadTester();
    
    // Test 1: 100K+ Concurrent Users Simulation
    await test.step('High Concurrency Load Test', async () => {
      const concurrentUsers = 500; // Scaled down for E2E (full load testing separately)
      const userSessions = [];
      
      // Create multiple browser contexts
      for (let i = 0; i < concurrentUsers; i++) {
        const context = await browser.newContext();
        const page = await context.newPage();
        userSessions.push({ context, page, userId: `user_${i}` });
      }
      
      // Simulate concurrent dashboard access
      const dashboardAccessPromises = userSessions.map(async ({ page, userId }) => {
        try {
          // Login
          await page.goto('/login');
          await page.fill('[data-testid="email"]', `${userId}@test.com`);
          await page.fill('[data-testid="password"]', 'testpass123');
          await page.click('[data-testid="login-btn"]');
          
          // Access dashboard
          await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
          
          // Perform typical user actions
          await page.click('[data-testid="refresh-dashboard"]');
          await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
          
          // Query data
          await page.fill('[data-testid="search-query"]', 'sales by region');
          await page.click('[data-testid="execute-search"]');
          await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="search-results"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
          
          return { userId, status: 'success', timestamp: Date.now() };
        } catch (error) {
          return { userId, status: 'error', error: error.message, timestamp: Date.now() };
        }
      });
      
      // Execute all concurrent sessions
      const results = await Promise.allSettled(dashboardAccessPromises);
      
      // Analyze results
      const successfulSessions = results.filter(r => 
        r.status === 'fulfilled' && r.value.status === 'success'
      ).length;
      
      const successRate = (successfulSessions / concurrentUsers) * 100;
      expect(successRate).toBeGreaterThan(95); // 95%+ success rate under load
      
      // Cleanup sessions
      for (const { context } of userSessions) {
        await context.close();
      }
    });

    // Test 2: Memory Usage Under Load
    await test.step('Memory Usage Monitoring', async () => {
      const memoryTester = new MemoryTester();
      
      // Baseline memory measurement
      const baselineMemory = await memoryTester.getCurrentMemoryUsage();
      
      // Create heavy data processing scenario
      const page = await browser.newPage();
      await page.goto('/analytics/advanced');
      
      // Load multiple large datasets simultaneously
      const largeDatasetTasks = Array(10).fill(null).map(async (_, i) => {
        await memoryTester.loadLargeDataset(`dataset_${i}`, 100000); // 100K records each
      });
      
      await Promise.all(largeDatasetTasks);
      
      // Measure peak memory
      const peakMemory = await memoryTester.getCurrentMemoryUsage();
      const memoryIncrease = peakMemory - baselineMemory;
      
      // Should not exceed 2GB memory increase
      expect(memoryIncrease).toBeLessThan(2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024);
      
      // Test garbage collection
      await page.click('[data-testid="clear-cache"]');
      await page.waitForTimeout(5000); // Allow GC
      
      const finalMemory = await memoryTester.getCurrentMemoryUsage();
      const memoryRecovered = peakMemory - finalMemory;
      
      // Should recover at least 70% of memory
      expect(memoryRecovered).toBeGreaterThan(memoryIncrease * 0.7);
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
describe('WebSocket Connection Stability', () => {

        { name: 'Connection Timeout', action: () => wsHandler.simulateTimeout(30000) }
      ];
      
      for (const scenario of testScenarios) {
        console.log(`Testing: ${scenario.name}`);
        
        // Execute test scenario
        await scenario.action();
        
        // Validate connection recovery
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="connection-status"]')).toHaveText('Connected', { timeout: 10000 });
        
        // Validate data synchronization
        await wsHandler.sendTestMessage({ type: 'update', data: { timestamp: Date.now() } });
        await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="last-update"]')).not.toContainText('--', { timeout: 5000 });
      }
    });

      }
    });

});
```

## Error Handling & Recovery Testing

### 1. Network Failure Recovery

```typescript
// e2e/tests/error-recovery.spec.ts
describe('Error Handling and Recovery', () => {
  test('Network Failure Recovery Mechanisms', async ({ page, context }) => {
    const networkTester = new NetworkTester(page);
    
    // Test 1: Network Disconnection Recovery
    await test.step('Network Disconnection Handling', async () => {
      await page.goto('/dashboard');
      
      // Verify normal operation
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard-loading"]')).not.toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard-content"]')).toBeVisible();
      
      // Simulate network disconnection
      await context.setOffline(true);
      
      // Attempt dashboard refresh
      await page.reload();
      
      // Should show offline indicator
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="offline-indicator"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="offline-message"]')).toContainText('Working offline');
      
      // Validate cached content availability
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="cached-dashboard"]')).toBeVisible();
      
      // Restore network connection
      await context.setOffline(false);
      
      // Should automatically reconnect
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="online-indicator"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="sync-complete"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
    });

    // Test 2: API Error Handling
    await test.step('API Error Handling', async () => {
      // Mock API failures
      await page.route('**/api/dashboards**', route => {
        route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Internal Server Error' })
        });
      });
      
      await page.goto('/dashboard');
      
      // Should show graceful error state
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="error-boundary"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="error-message"]')).toContainText('Unable to load dashboard');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="retry-button"]')).toBeVisible();
      
      // Test retry mechanism
      await page.unroute('**/api/dashboards**'); // Remove mock
      await page.click('[data-testid="retry-button"]');
      
      // Should recover successfully
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard-content"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    });

    // Test 3: Data Corruption Prevention
    await test.step('Data Corruption Prevention', async () => {
      await page.goto('/dashboard/create');
      
      // Create dashboard with complex configuration
      await page.fill('[data-testid="dashboard-name"]', 'Test Dashboard');
      
      // Add multiple components
      const components = [
        { type: 'chart', config: { chartType: 'line', dataSource: 'sales' } },
        { type: 'metric', config: { metric: 'revenue', format: 'currency' } },
        { type: 'table', config: { columns: ['name', 'value', 'change'] } }
      ];
      
      for (const component of components) {
        await addDashboardComponent(page, component);
      }
      
      // Simulate save interruption
      const savePromise = page.click('[data-testid="save-dashboard"]');
      
      // Interrupt save process
      await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
      await context.setOffline(true);
      
      try {
        await savePromise;
      } catch (error) {
        // Expected to fail
      }
      
      // Restore connection
      await context.setOffline(false);
      
      // Validate auto-recovery of unsaved changes
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-indicator"]')).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="auto-save-recovery"]')).toBeVisible();
      
      // Complete save
      await page.click('[data-testid="save-dashboard"]');
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="save-success"]')).toBeVisible();
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
      await page.click('[data-testid="save-changes"]');
      
      // Validate changes reflected in second tab
      await expect(secondTab.locator('[data-testid="dashboard-title"]')).toHaveText('Updated Title', { timeout: 5000 });
      
      // Test conflict resolution
      await secondTab.click('[data-testid="edit-dashboard"]');
      await secondTab.fill('[data-testid="dashboard-title"]', 'Conflicting Title');
      
      await page.fill('[data-testid="dashboard-title"]', 'Another Title');
      
      // Both tabs try to save simultaneously
      const [save1, save2] = await Promise.allSettled([
        page.click('[data-testid="save-changes"]'),
        secondTab.click('[data-testid="save-changes"]')
      ]);
      
      // Validate conflict resolution UI appears
      const conflictDialogs = [
        page.locator('[data-testid="merge-conflict-dialog"]'),
        secondTab.locator('[data-testid="merge-conflict-dialog"]')
      ];
      
      const visibleDialogs = await Promise.all(
        conflictDialogs.map(dialog => dialog.isVisible())
      );
      
      expect(visibleDialogs.some(visible => visible)).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});
```

## Technical Quality Validation

### 1. API Response Time Consistency

```typescript
// e2e/tests/api-performance.spec.ts
describe('API Performance Consistency', () => {
  test('API Response Time Validation (<500ms)', async ({ page }) => {
    const apiTester = new APIPerformanceTester();
    
    await test.step('Critical API Endpoints Performance', async () => {
      const criticalEndpoints = [
        {
          name: 'Dashboard List',
          url: '/api/dashboards',
          method: 'GET',
          expectedMaxTime: 500
        },
        {
          name: 'Query Execution',
          url: '/api/queries/execute',
          method: 'POST',
          body: { sql: 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL \'30 days\'' },
          expectedMaxTime: 3000
        },
        {
          name: 'Natural Language Processing',
          url: '/api/nlp/convert',
          method: 'POST',
          body: { query: 'Show me sales by region' },
          expectedMaxTime: 2000
        },
        {
          name: 'Real-time Data',
          url: '/api/realtime/metrics',
          method: 'GET',
          expectedMaxTime: 500
        }
      ];
      
      for (const endpoint of criticalEndpoints) {
        const performanceResults = [];
        
        // Test each endpoint 10 times
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
          const startTime = performance.now();
          
          const response = await apiTester.makeRequest({
            url: endpoint.url,
            method: endpoint.method,
            body: endpoint.body
          });
          
          const responseTime = performance.now() - startTime;
          
          performanceResults.push({
            attempt: i + 1,
            responseTime,
            statusCode: response.status,
            success: response.ok
          });
          
          expect(response.ok).toBe(true);
        }
        
        // Analyze performance statistics
        const responseTimes = performanceResults.map(r => r.responseTime);
        const averageTime = responseTimes.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / responseTimes.length;
        const maxTime = Math.max(...responseTimes);
        const minTime = Math.min(...responseTimes);
        
        // Performance assertions
        expect(averageTime).toBeLessThan(endpoint.expectedMaxTime);
        expect(maxTime).toBeLessThan(endpoint.expectedMaxTime * 2); // Allow 100% variance for max
        
        console.log(`${endpoint.name} Performance:`, {
          average: `${averageTime.toFixed(2)}ms`,
          min: `${minTime.toFixed(2)}ms`,
          max: `${maxTime.toFixed(2)}ms`,
          threshold: `${endpoint.expectedMaxTime}ms`
        });
      }
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
          activeUsers: document.querySelector('[data-testid="active-users"]')?.textContent,
          totalRevenue: document.querySelector('[data-testid="total-revenue"]')?.textContent,
          conversionRate: document.querySelector('[data-testid="conversion-rate"]')?.textContent
        };
      });
      
      // Trigger data update via API
      await dbTester.simulateDataUpdate({
        activeUsers: parseInt(initialMetrics.activeUsers.replace(/,/g, '')) + 50,
        totalRevenue: parseFloat(initialMetrics.totalRevenue.replace(/[$,]/g, '')) + 1500,
        conversionRate: parseFloat(initialMetrics.conversionRate.replace('%', '')) + 0.1
      });
      
      // Validate real-time updates (should appear within 2 seconds)
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="active-users"]')).not.toHaveText(initialMetrics.activeUsers, { timeout: 3000 });
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="total-revenue"]')).not.toHaveText(initialMetrics.totalRevenue, { timeout: 3000 });
      
      // Validate data accuracy
      const updatedMetrics = await page.evaluate(() => {
        return {
          activeUsers: document.querySelector('[data-testid="active-users"]')?.textContent,
          totalRevenue: document.querySelector('[data-testid="total-revenue"]')?.textContent,
          conversionRate: document.querySelector('[data-testid="conversion-rate"]')?.textContent
        };
      });
      
      expect(parseInt(updatedMetrics.activeUsers.replace(/,/g, ''))).toBeGreaterThan(parseInt(initialMetrics.activeUsers.replace(/,/g, '')));
      expect(parseFloat(updatedMetrics.totalRevenue.replace(/[$,]/g, ''))).toBeGreaterThan(parseFloat(initialMetrics.totalRevenue.replace(/[$,]/g, '')));
    });
  });
});
```

## Security Validation for Enterprise Data Handling

### 1. Data Encryption and Access Control

```typescript
// e2e/tests/security-validation.spec.ts
describe('Enterprise Security Validation', () => {
  test('Data Encryption and Access Control', async ({ page, context }) => {
    const securityTester = new SecurityTester(page);
    
    await test.step('Data Transmission Security', async () => {
      // Intercept network requests to validate encryption
      const requests = [];
      page.on('request', request => {
        if (request.url().includes('/api/')) {
          requests.push({
            url: request.url(),
            method: request.method(),
            headers: request.headers()
          });
        }
      });
      
      await page.goto('/dashboard');
      await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
      
      // Validate all API requests use HTTPS
      for (const request of requests) {
        expect(request.url).toMatch(/^https:/);
        expect(request.headers['authorization']).toBeTruthy();
      }
      
      // Test data at rest encryption
      const sensitiveData = await securityTester.getSensitiveDataSample();
      expect(sensitiveData.encrypted).toBe(true);
      expect(sensitiveData.algorithm).toBe('AES-256-GCM');
    });

    await test.step('Role-Based Access Control Validation', async () => {
      const testRoles = [
        {
          role: 'admin',
          permissions: ['view_all', 'edit_all', 'delete_all', 'manage_users'],
          restrictedActions: []
        },
        {
          role: 'analyst',
          permissions: ['view_own', 'edit_own', 'create_dashboards'],
          restrictedActions: ['delete_dashboards', 'manage_users']
        },
        {
          role: 'viewer',
          permissions: ['view_shared', 'export_reports'],
          restrictedActions: ['edit_dashboards', 'create_dashboards', 'manage_users']
        }
      ];
      
      for (const roleTest of testRoles) {
        await securityTester.switchToRole(roleTest.role);
        
        // Test allowed permissions
        for (const permission of roleTest.permissions) {
          const hasPermission = await securityTester.testPermission(permission);
          expect(hasPermission).toBe(true);
        }
        
        // Test restricted actions
        for (const restriction of roleTest.restrictedActions) {
          const isRestricted = await securityTester.testRestriction(restriction);
          expect(isRestricted).toBe(true);
        }
      }
    });

    await test.step('SQL Injection Prevention', async () => {
      const maliciousInputs = [
        "'; DROP TABLE users; --",
        "1' OR '1'='1",
        "admin' --",
        "1; DELETE FROM dashboards; --",
        "UNION SELECT password FROM users WHERE username='admin' --"
      ];
      
      await page.goto('/analytics');
      
      for (const maliciousInput of maliciousInputs) {
        // Try malicious input in query field
        await page.fill('[data-testid="query-input"]', maliciousInput);
        await page.click('[data-testid="execute-query"]');
        
        // Should either sanitize or reject with proper error
        const errorMessage = await page.locator('[data-testid="query-error"]').textContent();
        const resultsVisible = await page.locator('[data-testid="query-results"]').isVisible();
        
        // Should not execute malicious query
        expect(resultsVisible).toBe(false);
        expect(errorMessage).toContain('Invalid query');
      }
    });

    await test.step('Session Security', async () => {
      // Test session timeout
      await page.goto('/dashboard');
      
      // Simulate idle session
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        // Mock session expiration
        localStorage.setItem('sessionTimeout', Date.now() + 100); // 100ms from now
      });
      
      await page.waitForTimeout(200);
      await page.reload();
      
      // Should redirect to login
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="login-form"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });
      
      // Test concurrent session handling
      const secondContext = await page.context().browser().newContext();
      const secondPage = await secondContext.newPage();
      
      // Login in second context with same user
      await securityTester.loginWithSameUser(secondPage);
      
      // First session should be invalidated
      await page.reload();
      await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="session-expired"]')).toBeVisible();
    });
  });
});
```

## Quality Assessment Framework

### E2E Integration Quality Scoring

```typescript
// utils/quality-assessment.ts
export class E2EQualityAssessment {
  private testResults: TestResult[] = [];
  private qualityMetrics = {
    coreUserFlows: { weight: 0.25, threshold: 90 },
    dataFlowIntegration: { weight: 0.20, threshold: 85 },
    systemIntegrationPoints: { weight: 0.20, threshold: 90 },
    performanceUnderLoad: { weight: 0.15, threshold: 80 },
    errorHandlingRecovery: { weight: 0.10, threshold: 85 },
    userExperienceValidation: { weight: 0.10, threshold: 85 }
  };

  calculateOverallScore(): QualityScore {
    const categoryScores = {};
    
    Object.keys(this.qualityMetrics).forEach(category => {
      const categoryTests = this.testResults.filter(test => test.category === category);
      const successRate = categoryTests.filter(test => test.passed).length / categoryTests.length * 100;
      categoryScores[category] = {
        score: successRate,
        passed: successRate >= this.qualityMetrics[category].threshold,
        weight: this.qualityMetrics[category].weight
      };
    });
    
    const weightedScore = Object.values(categoryScores).reduce((total, category) => 
      total + (category.score * category.weight), 0
    );
    
    return {
      overallScore: weightedScore,
      categoryBreakdown: categoryScores,
      qualityThresholdMet: weightedScore >= 85,
      recommendations: this.generateRecommendations(categoryScores)
    };
  }
  
  private generateRecommendations(scores: any): string[] {
    const recommendations = [];
    
    Object.entries(scores).forEach(([category, data]) => {
      if (!data.passed) {
        recommendations.push(`Improve ${category}: Current ${data.score.toFixed(1)}%, Target ${this.qualityMetrics[category].threshold}%`);
      }
    });
    
    return recommendations;
  }
}
```
